rules.doc_title: 全栈AI产品架构SOP（Next.js + Supabase 高并发与低成本）
rules.rule: Always connect Supabase via port 6543 Transaction Pooler in Serverless API routes; never direct-connect 5432.

check.assertion: Serverless API 路由不得直连 5432

rules.source: Knowledge-OS/02-Architecture/03-全栈AI产品高并发与低成本架构SOP.md

rules.rule: In Vercel or Serverless API routes, connect via Supabase Port 6543 (Transaction Pooler).

check.assertion: 数据库连接串必须使用 6543 事务池端口

rules.rule: Always use req.text() raw body for webhook signature verification; never use req.json().

check.assertion: Webhook 验签必须读取原始正文，不得用 json() 解析后再验签

rules.rule: Disable server-side prepared statements (e.g., prepare: false or pgbouncer=true) in database drivers when connecting via Transaction Pooler to prevent Error 42P05.

check.assertion: 事务池连接必须显式关闭服务端 Prepared Statements

rules.rule: Mount sliding window rate limit on all public API routes to prevent bill shock from abuse.

check.assertion: 公开 API 必须接入 Upstash 滑动窗口限流

rules.rule: Record event_id with UNIQUE constraint in database to guarantee idempotent webhook processing.

check.assertion: 事件表必须给 event_id 加 UNIQUE 约束保证幂等

rules.doc_title: 全栈AI产品架构SOP（Next.js + Supabase 高并发与低成本）
rules.rule: Never import C++ native Node.js modules in Edge Runtime to prevent build failure and cold start blowup.
rules.source: Knowledge-OS/02-Architecture/03-全栈AI产品高并发与低成本架构SOP.md

rules.rule: Enforce AbortController 15-second timeout and per-user token consumption ceiling on LLM routes.

check.assertion: LLM 路由必须有超时中断与每用户 token 硬顶

rules.rule: Use Upstash Redis with HTTP/REST protocol in Serverless environment; never use TCP Redis connections.
Deploy /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt in public/ to reduce AI search engine hallucination.
